comingLast.roast: somebody start a raffle so he has a reason to stay put
4 from 1 - do it for the car keys
3 points from escape - Peebles has stopped watching his own card
3 holes left to avoid the double blue - 8 points does it
still out there on 19 - the clubhouse is doing his maths for him
on 17 with 4 to play - Peebles is quietly cheering against him
on 17 - the leaderboard reads top to bottom, everyone reads bottom first today
on 22 with 2 to play - scratch the plan, just add points, any points
averaging 1.4 a hole - the blue balls are warming up
Peebles needs him to stay exactly this bad for 3 more holes
